recs.name: Strong Meets Stronger
recs.tag: Don't think too hard about it, just go and have some fun.

lines.x: Oh, good! Zima, Leto, over here!
Quick! No lollygagging!
What, you need me to beat someone up?
A fight? I'm in, I'm in!
No, listen to me—

I don't know what dimwit decided to flash the snacks in front of Dobermann, but I've got that, plus a bunch of the Infected kids in for introductory fitness extracurriculars! You take care of them for me, pretty please—
Ooh, Snack Network stuff!
You want me... to take care of kids?
I wrote everything down for you here—!
Pretty pretty please—I'll promise I'll make it up to you with a nice meal—!
Wow, Instructor Dur-nar runs fast. Is she a Kuranta?
Why ask us to look after some kids?
Wait... yeah, why us? Do we look like babysitters?
And it's teaching a bunch of little ones who just got to Rhodes? Uhh...
Agh. Pain in my ass.
Pssh... it's just for a day. We'll grit our teeth and bear it. Let's go.
Haha... yeah, uh...
All praise to the indomitable General Zima, the only woman for the job...
Huh? Where are you going?
I'll leave you some honey! Not like I'm teaching a bunch of kids, they're all yours now! Yeah? Cool, we're cool? You've got this—
Hey!
Kakovo khuya!
(Just the thought of teaching a class gives me a headache.)
(Oh... sounds pretty chill?)
(Okay, lucky me.)
Hey, hey, hey, look over here, I'm giving the orders!
You thought you could act the big boy here? I beat you in one hit! But you're alright, you're goon #1 from today! And you're #2, and you're #3!
This is my turf now!
Hey, new girl! You came in last, so you're the last of the goons!
I'm the boss now, you hear? That's what you're calling me!
(Uh-huh? She beat all these kids into submission. She's pretty solid.)
(Wait, no, I've gotta turn that part of my brain off. This is my class to manage.)
Who died and made this scrawny brat king, huh?
(Maybe she'll behave if I beat her up?)
(Ugh, I can't do that. I'm an educator now.)
Hey, listen up, little punks! Your instructor's kind of tied up, so I'm filling in for today. Shape up!
Memo... here we go. Hey, you, with the mouth, get down from the bunker! I don't wanna hear you crying when you fall off, I'm no medic.
You don't talk to your boss like that, you goon! Cry, my butt! As if I'd ever fall off!
Yeah! Yeah!
(Argh. Hold it in. Don't hit her. Don't hit her.)
'Make sure they stay safe while you teach them the names of the machines and how to use them. You can also let them try training with them. But it's all about safety first!'
(Seriously, Dur-nar writes like her pen's trying to get away.)
Hey, get over here. Instructor Dur-nar left you some homework... Why are you standing around up there?
Pain in the... Listen to me, okay? Get down!
No! I'm the only one allowed up here, because I'm the boss!
Yeah, yeah!
(I'm this close to going up there and slamming her face onto the deck!)
The instructor asked me to help watch you guys. You can't be up there, it's dangerous! Get down, now!
Hmph, who cares?
I said, get down!
You're my goon, I don't listen to you! I'm your boss! You should be listening to me!
She's the boss! Do what she says!
Huh? You think I'm gonna do what you say? Do I seriously have to beat you up?
You can't beat me~ I'll use my Arts on you! I don't see any rocks on you, so you can't use Arts~
(Argh, this kid! How am I supposed to fight the urge to slug her?! Ugh, I oughta drag Leto back here and make her suffer—)
And I'm really strong! I don't need you to look after me! I want the Instructor!
Yeah, and your instructor told me to watch you!
You're my goon, I don't need you!
(The harder I push her, the more obnoxious she gets?)
(Wish Rosa was here. I can't do goody-two-shoes model student like she can. If that girl doesn't behave, the rest of these brats won't either...)
(This is never gonna end... I need to get her under control.)
You're strong, huh? I don't think so. If your instructor called me in, then I'm stronger than you, and that makes me the boss.
Don't try to lie to us! I'm the boss!
Not if I don't listen to you. What do you say we have a little contest?
Contest! Contest!
If you lose, you have to do whatever I say. If you win, I'll be your goon!
You're my goon anyway. I don't need to do any contests.
Oh, right, I'm already your goon, I... huh?
(Did I just get duped? Ugh! This sucks!)
If you don't accept my challenge, you're a coward, the lowest goon ever. You're just scared you'll lose. You're not fit to be the boss!
Huh?
I'm the boss, you're just a goon! Let's do it, we'll have a contest!
What are you good at?!
Knucklebones! I'm the super-duper-best at knucklebones!
I'll show you who's the boss!
Yeah, sure, we're on.
Fight! Fight!
I'm gonna show you what a real boss looks like, you're just a wannabe!
(I've played knucklebones a billion times. This punk's never gonna beat me...)
Alright, my turn!
(Grab, toss, catch... flip, then catch, then toss, one, two, three, one...)
Done.
Hmph! Anyone can do the first round.
Alright, second round then~
(Toss, catch two, toss, grab one catch one, toss, then catch...)
Drop, drop, drop!
(Like I would! Is this girl for real...? Oh?)
(One, two, three, one... cool, cool, round 2 done.)
Okay, round 3. Toss, grab, two, three, one...
Drop! Drop! C'mon, drop!!
Read 'em and weep~ Check it out, I'm going for the last round now.
Hmph, anyone could do that~ Like me!
(Phew—okay, stay cool.)
(Alright, go! Grab seven, toss! Catch, toss four, then grab, then toss, catch, three, two, one, done!)
Here goes the last move, kid~
(Eight, flip, catch!)
You dropped two you dropped two!
Two drops! Two drops!
Oh, man, lost it there. Pretty decent showing, though.
Your turn. C'mon, punk, show me how you knucklebone.
Hmph, I know, I know. Watch me.
And don't call me punk. You have to call me boss.
Sure, Boss. Show me!
(Ooooh, she's got skills... pretty slick movement, no wonder she's so sure of herself... definitely pretty up there. Almost done, here goes...)
Oh! You dropped three! You lose!
Alright, get over here and listen up. Also, don't ever climb on the bunker again.
Y—You cheated! That one didn't count!
What are you talking about? You're the one trying to cheat here! Sore loser!
I'm not a sore loser! I'm not!
I'm the boss, I can't be a sore loser!
She's not! She's not!
Hahahahaha! We can go again if you want!
One two three four five six seven... You grabbed seven. Progress, huh? But I got eight, so you lose again.
Alright, now it's time to shape up.
...Hmph.
Hm?
(What? I busted my ass coming up with this and she's not even gonna keep up her end of the deal?)
(Are all kids like this now?)
If you don't make good on your word, then your, uh... goons #1 and #2 won't respect you as a boss, right?
Fine. What do you want me to do?
Learn the names of the machines and how to use them, and if you want, you can try them out a bit.
Alright, fine. Let's go.
You got it, Boss!
(She looks beat. Is she depressed now? Yeah, okay, kids really are a pain in the ass!)
You, uh, you're actually pretty good at knucklebones. I've just been at it longer than you, that's all. I got more practice.
Shake your wrist on the last toss, and the stones turn out like this—makes a little forward-backward separation. Scatters less if you use the back of your hand to catch, lets you catch even more.
Give it a shot.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight...
Huh, it does.
Real handy, right? All cheered up now? Let's get going, then.
Learning time! Be good until Instructor Dur-nar gets back, and then I'll teach you the ultimate trick to knucklebones. You learn that, and you can beat anyone, anywhere.
Really?
Don't see why I'd lie to you.
Alright! You're the best, Miss!
She's the best! She's the best!
I'm not even teaching you, the hell are you chanting for? Listen up, class is in session!
(Hah. Now I'm getting some respect.)
Alright, here we go. Pay attention. This is a barbell, this rack over here's called a 'Smith machine.' You fix the barbell inside these rails here. Why do you think we do that?
So you can't take the barbell away?
Huh? No, the Smith machine restricts how the barbell slides, so it won't swing forwards or backwards while you train. That keeps your waist or knees from getting hurt.
This way, you can do squats... just hold it like this, then make sure your knees don't go over your feet, breathe out and crouch, breathe in and lift.

You can lie down here too, do presses, and buff up your arm strength. But you gotta watch out when you're training. Make your barbell too heavy and you can't lift it, and then if it crushes you, you're, uh. (Crosses throat and croaks)
So be careful as you can. Got it?
Got it! If we make the barbell too heavy, it's gonna snap us in half!
Huh? Uh...
I mean, yeah, it will if it's too heavy, so, real dangerous. Gotta watch out for that when you train.

Then this thing's a pull-up machine, horizontal and parallel bars. Back to the brace, both hands firm on the handles, then rest your arms on the beams, lift your body into the air, and do crunches like this. Works out your abs.
Uh... pretty hard to get injured on this. Anyone wanna try?
Yeah, I wanna try!
Little high for you. Lemme lift you up.
Hup!
I hold on here?
Yep, then elbows up, support your own body... You got it?
Yep!
Keep your upper body fixed, back and waist straight, put pressure into your abs. Okay, legs straight, then lift them up with just your abdominal strength, breathe in, out... good.
(Shaking heavily)
Oh, damn. You have Originium growing on your arms here. Don't chip it... does it hurt here?
Don't touch me!
Don't panic on the rack!
What are you gonna do if you hurt yourself?
You don't grow stones, right, Miss?
No... I don't. What's up?
Then you've gotta keep away from me.
C'mon, get down off the rack first.
Why do I have to keep away from you?
Because I'm sick, and people keep avoiding me, and hitting me with rocks. You're not growing stones, so why aren't you keeping away?
Forget that. There's a million people growing stones here, didn't Instructor Dur-nar tell you? Focus on your training!
When they hit you with rocks, did you fight back?
I did! Really hard!
Attagirl!
Uh... but fighting's bad, still, so don't get into dumb fights anymore.
Why?
Um... it's just bad. Listen, okay? No more random fighting from now on.
Okay.
Alright, that's enough training on this machine. Instructor Dur-nar's gonna teach you the standard stuff to do some other time, so lemme show you around the rest of the machines.
Miss, what's your name?
Huh? It's... Zima. My codename's, uh, Zima.
Codename?
Yeah, I'm called Zima now.
How about you?
I don't have a codename yet...
I'll tell you once I think of one!
Haha, sure.
Cool! Lessons over. You remember all that?
Obviously! I'm really smart!
We remember! We remember!
You can keep doing this course with Instructor Dur-nar, if you want. Not bad to learn how to train a little.
There's more than Instructor Dur-nar too. Other ops do some intro extracurriculars. You can go check them out, if you're into it.
Also, Rhodes Island has a bunch of other kids around your age. Go play with them, it's no sweat.
We're done. Just waiting for Instructor Dur-nar to come back now. Let me teach you that ultimate trick for knucklebones!
The ultimate trick!
Me too! Me too!
Sure, get over here, all of you. Watch this. But you gotta pay attention...
Heeey, I'm back! Got it all taken care of! No skin off my back!
Hi, Instructor.
Hi, Instructor.
Oh, Zima, thanks for your help. I'll take you out to dinner in a minute~... uh, where's Leto?
Hah. She bolted as soon as she heard anything about kids.
Hahaha, no dinner for her tonight then~ Talk to me, how did the classes go?
I taught them the names of all the machines and how to use them. They gave training a decent shot too. Great work all around.
Solid. I can take it from here, so you go unwind.
Sure, I'll put the machines away and stuff.
Kids, gather 'round. Let me check what you've learned, and then class is out for the day.
Umm... This is a barbell, you put it on this rack, and you fix it, so you can train your leg muscles. If you lie down here and do presses, you train your arms.
This is...
That one's...
Nice, you've learned a lot. Does anywhere hurt after training?
Nope!
Come here, let me just make sure now.
Mm-hm, no injuries. Good work~
That's it for today, then. Everyone, back to your dorms, get some proper rest. You can head to the cafeteria tonight for some of your favorites. Take a walk around, too.
Alrighty~, dismissed!
Bye, Instructor, bye, Miss Zima~
Bye~
Yeah, see you.
Is Miss Zima gonna leave now?
Yep~ Today was a little special. Zima's done her duty. I'll be the one teaching you from now on.
But... can Miss Zima come take the course with me?
Oh?
This kiddo's gotten surprisingly attached to you, hasn't she?
Sure... huh?
You're not coming back again, Miss Zima?
Uh. Yeah, I was just kinda helping out here today, this stuff's all too basic for me. So I guess I... um... I won't be back.
You listen to what your instructors tell you, get used to life at Rhodes. You'll have a good time.
Oh...
Haha, isn't that funny? I never expected this.
Kiddo, what did she do that got you liking her so much?
Miss Zima told me not to get into fights anymore, fighting is bad!
Mm-hm... oh-hoh... Zima says no fighting... pfff, okay, off you go, back to your dorm to rest~
Okay... bye, Instructor, bye, Miss Zima...
Miss Zima... I have class in this training room the day after tomorrow too.
Mmwuh?
Oh, there she goes.
If I had to guess, you have no idea what she was getting at?
She means she wants you to come see her, silly, hahaha! Just what did you do to make her fall in love with you like that?
Why don't I get that kind of treatment...? Am I too scary or something?
Ehhh? Someone's calling me... I'd better get going.
Here's my meal card. Go get yourself dinner. Just slip it under my door on your way back.
Treat yourself!
Sure. Thanks, Instructor! See you later!
Haha! Found you! I've been looking all over!
I got us a very special honey drink!
Gah! You've got some nerve, you know that?
Ah, knock it off! I've had this in my collection forever! Za nashu druzhba~
Hmph! You ran and left me with a pack of kids all day!
Hahahahahaha, that's our General Zima, friend to children everywhere~ Hahaha!
Yeah, if only I was as good as you at retreating, General Leto!
Okay, okay, no bickering in front of the honey... drink up, come on! If this isn't an apology, I don't know what is.
Good, right? I told you it was from my private reserve!
Mm... it's pretty good.
Come on! Tell me what babysitting capers you got up to today.
What are you expecting? I just ran their class.
But... the weird thing is, there was this little girl who kind of took to me, I think...
A little girl who approves of you? I don't suppose you beat up her friends and scared her into submission, did you?
Do YOU want a beating?!
Hey hey hey, no no, keep going keep going, I'm listening.
Thing is... she didn't want me to leave when class was over. Said she wanted me to go to the next one with her... I'm sure as hell not going, I already know all that stuff, but...
What's wrong? Swallow your tongue?
I can't figure out why.
Why what?
She actually seems to like me...? Why?
I thought I was real strict, plus I embarrassed her by beating her in a game. Dunno about hate, but I didn't think she'd like me all that much... but then she wanted me to go to class with her?
And I feel like I was sort of like, all, uh... you know. But she doesn't really seem to care, she just wants me to go again...
Glug, glug, glug... phaaah! Wanna know what I think? I think you're reading too much into it, and she thinks you're great and that's why she likes you, duh!
And besides, why would she not?
And that's why she likes you!!!!
We're in the cafeteria, keep it down!
Ulp! Quit shaking me! I'm drinking... I'm all d—d-d-dizzy, I'm gonna buy a water bottle and take my sweet time...
Y—Y—You wait here for me...
Gah, you honey drunk gopnitsa. I'll be looking the other way the day you fall off the landship.
Rrngh... specialty honey drink, seriously...
Ulk. Head kind of spinning...
Oh, yeah... why wouldn't she like me?
Honestly, not like I should care... those... those... that punk sure doesn't mind, so...
...I don't mind...
Heheh.
Two days later...
Alright, our course begins today~
Hi, Instructor.
Why so gloomy?
Um... no reason.
Guess who's here—!
Hahah! It's your big girl, Zima!!
—Yay!!!

recs.name: Burning on a Winter Night
recs.tag: If not for this fire... No, there is no if.

lines.x: (Lada's... not here either?)
(She sure has been busy lately.)
C-Captain!
Hm? Oh, hey, Mousse.
You did nice in that last combat drill.
Heheh. I went through Leto's brutal training course, after all.
Huh? Rosalind?
Mm-hm! When the new squad rosters were posted, I saw you were my captain... I remembered the two of you were best friends, so I went and asked her how best to work with you in battle.
She agreed to train with me straight away! And she taught me this little trick for when I fight alongside you...
What's the trick?
She said, 'If Sonya heads up, just head up with her!'
That dumbass... Grrr... I was wondering why I couldn't even find her. She was training with you, huh?
No, not just me... there's been a lot of operators fighting for the chance to train with her.
And the way it's been as of late, once she's in the training room, she spends the whole day there... *sigh* I wonder when I'll ever have energy as exuberant as her?
Jeez, you don't see that every day.
I've never seen a newbie like that. Fresh transfer from Logistics to the front line, if you could believe it.
Bored clean through a solid steel plate with that custom crossbow she's got... I'm sweating here!
That's not even the scariest part... did you hear? Stormeye was talking up the newbie hard during combat drills. A first for him.
(Is that Natalya they're talking about? No way.)
(Not like that should be surprising. Weird. The hell am I feeling...?)
(Shouldn't I be happy for her?)
(Whatever, this sucks... Guess I'll take a look. Should just about be there.)
(Is that voices from inside? Sounds like a lotta people...)
Huh? Is someone at the door?
Allow me, Royal Detective, to get to the bottom of this.
Z... Zima! I assume you're here for Istina?
She's... currently sharing her thoughts on A Winter Campfire with us! This book right here!
I'll bring her over!
W—Wait, no, no need...
Not like it's anything important. I'll just come back a little later.
*huff*.
Five days later...
Maybe Rosalind's here?
Yeah, nope. Didn't think so.
Took me the whole morning just to fry one pirozhki. Still doesn't taste half as good as Lada's.
I went and borrowed A Winter Campfire from May. Should be able to finish reading it tonight.
And that black tea still tastes so bad I wanna die... but I get it now. Natalya's been relying on that weird mouthfeel to stay awake the whole time!
Nowadays...
Life's simple... for us, the USSG. It should've been like this before, shouldn't it?
Uh... Nearl. You heard all that?
Whatever, perfect timing.
I'm not totally cool with the squad assignments. I think Istina, Leto and the rest would do better on a team with me.
Why?
You... C'mon, you're messing around, right? We've always been a team.
Our squads at current are not based on whether its members come from the same place, or how deeply they know each other.
It is Rhodes Island strategic necessity. You're bound for the battlefield.
Our plans are made in the wake of the most responsible decisions, with full stock taken of our mission objectives, coupled with the best of every operator's individual abilities and team synergies.
How come you never seem to get pissed off?
Zima, very soon you'll be leading a reorganized squad to carry out your mission.
You must remember: here and now, you are a team captain.
Hmph... yeah, I hear that. 'Captain.'
So that's my new title, huh?
Phew... oof, it gets real cold here at night...
Captain, you want a smoke? Warm yourself up?
I mean... I assume you're old enough?
I don't smoke.
Also, you wanna be careful.
Ursus gets real dry this time of year. One spark can catch the moment it hits grass.
Got it. Guess I won't smoke either.
Eesh... it's freezing... say, don't you guys think this mission's a little slow-going?
Do we really need this many hands looking for one shipment of lost meds?
I... I believe Nearl must have had strategical considerations in arranging for us to go!
*sigh* Arrangements, my butt.
We're a bunch of rookies, we don't have any actual combat experience. What, are you hoping commander's about to send us on harder missions?
I'm just sad I didn't get put in the same squad as that one Medical girl I trained with. I was even gonna...
Wait! Guys, look...
There—There's fire that way!
C'mon. We're gonna check it out.
O—Oh, jeez... this whole tent got burnt down...
Rhodes Island logo... this was one of our temp stations.
Are the airtight containers in there the missing medical supplies?
Anna, compare those with the designs for Medical's pharms.
Um... Captain, Istina's not in our squad...
Goddammit.
Captain, permission to speak freely, you've been kind of distracted this whole mission.
You, Istina and Rosa and the rest were one student group, right?
But we're a whole squad here. Didn't The Radiant Knight tell us to trust in our teammates out in the field?
Um...
Captain, I've made a rough check. That should be the lost shipment in the tent.
It's gotta be! The packaging's the exact same as the stuff awaiting transit on the landship.
Let's go, c'mon, everyone ease up! Let's bring the spoils of victory home... Who knew it'd be this easy!
Wa... Hey, wait!
Geugh...
Wh—Who are you guys? Get outta my way!
No more funny business!
Last one was your arm. The next one's aimed at your head if you try anything!
Who the hell are you people?
No comment.
Drop your meds, your equipment, and any other valuables you have right here, and we'll let him go.
Bratany!
Captain...
Ugh.
Seanson, you hold steady.
Huh? Captain, don't do anything rash...
Mousse! We're going in!
R—Roger!
Gargh!
Ugh...
Hey, kid.
You're their boss, aren't you?
Speak!
He's passed out.
Hmph. Guess he couldn't take a beating.
Seanson, you okay?
I'm surprised you remember my name, Captain.
It's okay, my wounds aren't deep... I can do some simple first-aid on myself...
Swear my heart was about to leap out of my mouth, though.
I don't think I'm fit for the battlefield... I need to hand in an application to command later, see if I can't get transferred to Logistics or Medical.
Coward.
Lucci, how are things in the tent?
I gave a search. Those supply boxes are definitely Rhodes Island's, without a doubt.
But they're all empty inside! The pharmaceuticals are gone!
Dammit! Wake up, you dumbass! Quit playing dead!
Zima seizes the bandit leader by the scruff and tosses him to and fro—vigorously enough to throw the goods in his pockets all across the floor.
Is... Is that... a Peterheim Middle School... student ID?
Where am I...?
Morning, bozo.
Y—You were in the forest... Where are we? What are you doing with me? Where are my bratany?
20 Questions the second you wake up, huh? You're a pain in the ass.
We brought you back, gave you a checkup, put you on energy supplements for your malnutrition, and got you permission to stay in a dorm. Feel free not to thank us, I guess, but—
At least show a little respect?
Daniil.
How do you know my name...?
Your student ID.
Didn't think I'd run into a schoolmate in some crappy forest all the way out there.
You don't know me?
General Zima? I didn't even recognize you.
Alright, whatever, you remember me. That makes this a lot simpler.
I've got one question, that's it.
The medical stuff. Where did it go?
I sold it.
You sold it? Then where's the money?
...Spent it all.
Are you serious?
You dickhead... If only I knew you'd pull this shit. Should've let those noble kids beat on you longer.
Okay. You sold it. So tell me about your buyer, your broker, and the amount of money your stolen goods got, and don't miss a single thing.
You need to understand—Rhodes Island might be housing you for now, but if you don't cooperate, we can just hand you over to the Ursus police.
I must be dreaming. General Zima using 'I'll sic the police on you' to threaten me... It looks like everyone's changed since Chernobog.
General Zima... no, Sonya. I would've probably done as you told me if we were back in Peterheim.
I had no choice there, after all. It was either follow you, or beg those noble shitstains for forgiveness as they kicked me about.
Who says you can't follow me now? You'll be part of the USSG until whenever.
This is Rhodes Island. It was Rhodes Island that sheltered us, and brought us out of Chernobog.
I don't actually know if you can join too... but I figure as long as you're wiling to work, it should be fine.
Hmph. The Ursus Student Self-governing Group, was it? What a nostalgic name.
If Anna's here too, then why wasn't she with you out there? Those two bratany in your squad probably don't have half the brain cells combined that Anna did.
Grr. Those are my squaddies. I won't have you talking shit about them.
And Anna's... the group's got their own things to do.
Hmph, their own things. You weren't really thinking you could lead the USSG your whole life, were you?
If Rhodes Island is sheltering you, then they must have taken in Anna and the rest too.
So how could they have clung to your side forever, the way they were before?
Ugh.
Of course they're not gonna be with me all the time, and that's for the best.
I never really planned for the future, anyway.
I used to think, if we all made it out of Chernobog... then no matter what the future brought, it couldn't be worse than that, could it?
Real talk, Rhodes Island is just fine to us now. We got used to life here, and we've all found our own thing to do.
For me, Peterheim's in the past. Same for the USSG.
Five days ago...
H—Huh? Disband?
You want to disband the USSG?
I'mma sniff a sec... doesn't smell sweet... you're not honey-drunk.
Wait, what's this crazy talk, then?!
It's not crazy talk. It's my official decision.
Sonya...
Natalya just got back. Didn't we agree to welcome her home together? To celebrate her achievements?
Even if you're of a mind to disband the USSG... now's not the time to bring that up, is it?
No. Now's the perfect time.
Our group was founded on the idea that we'd support each other through those hellish days.
But now, we're out. All of us in the USSG have found stuff we'd rather put our energy into aboard Rhodes Island.
Like Natalya has. She started out not knowing how to fight at all, now she's posting great scores in combat drills... She's the best out of all of us, the way she's changed.
I used to worry I wouldn't make a decent leader... Maybe I've earned your trust and support after so long.
But that doesn't mean I can hold onto my position forever.
I used to be the USSG's leader, now I'm the captain of a Rhodes Island advance squad... and there's more possibilities out there for Sonya's future.
All of your futures.
Um—I—still don't really get it.
How does it actually affect us if the Group disbands?
Even if the USSG's gone, the five of us will still be together, right?
Lada, this is different. Don't you wanna be a great chef? And Anna says she wants to go study at university.
For our past selves, all of that was empty dreams. But now, we have better footing, and I think... no, I'm sure everyone's got a way better future in store.
We're gonna be more than just members of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. We're all gonna better ourselves.
Well, I'm lost for words. Hats off to our leader.
I certainly never expected... that the first to leave the Ursus Student Self-governing Group would be you, of all people.
It's not just me leaving, it's the USSG disbanding! You're all free now!
Sonya.
Is that how you've decided to resolve our futures?
I mean... I assume you're old enough?
Urk...
So how could they have clung to your side forever, the way they were before?
Urk...
How does it actually affect us if the Group disbands?
Blughk—
She vomits, cleanly as could be.
Sonya, you know you're not omnipotent.
This is for the best for every single member of the USSG.

lines.st: The water in the toilet basin becomes a whirlpool, like it's about to suck me in, pull me away from a life where they exist.
Right now, my future lies before me.

lines.x: Seriously... I thought we'd get to rest up for a while.
All we had was a few days back on the landship, and now they sent us out to a place like this.
It's way colder than last time.
Plus our captain still acts like she's got it all to win... Just kill me.
You think? She looks to me like she's just forcing herself along.
Actually, did you hear? That student group of theirs broke up!
Huh? Is she for real?
What the hell are you two bitching about now?
Oh, Captain! No bitching here, none at all!
Yeah, you're off the hook this time.
Lucci, pass me a smoke.
Captain, The Radiant Knight went out of her way to give me a warning.
I'm never gonna hand out smokes again. Don't hurt me for it.
Ugh. Screw you, Nearl, stepping into my business.
Oh, yeah, uh, Captain...
What?
Did Daniil really just tell you the village's location like that?
They hid that many medical supplies in this one village?
It was Nearl who told me... Literally no idea how she got it out of Daniil, though.
But she's always going around all like 'just leave it to me,' so I'm not that surprised.
But is there really going to be an inhabited village... in a place this desolate?
Captain, you don't think The Radiant Knight's testing you, do you...?
L—Look!
Over there, I think that's an old man.
What could it be, youngster?
Fresh faces are seldom sighted, out here in this tundra.
Is there a village around here?
Do you see that hut over there? Go past it, and you'll find our village.
You don't... uh, excuse me, but you wouldn't happen to know a Daniil, would you?
Daniil, eh...?
Chi—Chief! Trouble!
What is it?
There's a fire in the village! It's about to reach the storehouse! All our food for the winter is in there!
*pant*... *pant*... Captain Zima! We're done evacuating all villagers on the east side!
North side villager evacuation complete!
West and south villagers are all evacuated too!
Got it. Mousse, you go double-check the headcount with the village chief. Then help them put out the fire. These villagers built their own houses, brick by brick, so every room you can save is a win.
R—Roger!
Seanson, Lucci, with me. This next part of the job's gonna be tricky... We need to head into the storehouse, and get the medical supplies out.
What? So they were in the village!
Yeah... I'll tell you the whole story after we're done here.
But... you're telling me it's all in there? Captain, that's not a small fire.
I know, and this isn't an order.
If you don't want to go, I'll go by myself.
Captain, this isn't a want-to-or-not kind of scenario...
Dedushka, dedushka, will that bratan come back to help us?
In the spring, he said he'd return by autumn.
And then autumn came and he did, don't you remember? And he harvested the grains with us.
You silly little fool. That boy didn't say he'd come back in winter.
No, he said he'd come back the next time we're out of rye bread.
But—but...
...Dedushka, weren't you just saying, we might not have bread to eat this winter?
So the bratan must be coming back soon!
*sigh*...
Come, sweet child. Be good now, your babushka is waiting for us over there.
Change of plans. We rescue the villagers' food first.
B—But, Captain, given the situation, these villagers could well be in cahoots with Daniil!
They stole our stuff, and we're going to help them?
That's two different things... C'mon, you guys, with me.
That's an order this time. And if we can't get the medical supplies thing squared off... I'll take the blame.
Say, how much grain do you figure could be left in there?
Given the present conflagration, the portion closest to the fire's origin is out of the question. Still, at least some of the outer portion should remain.
Hm? I don't think so~ There's still a chance for the inside part, it might just be a little overbaked!
After all that training, we finally get a shot at the real thing, huh? Move move move, girls, full steam ahead!
All else being equal, we've arrived in time. If we concert our efforts, perhaps we can still avert complete disaster.
Y—You guys...
What are you doing here?
Back then...
You! You idiot... Do you even know what you've done?
It was an accident...
Save it! Quickly, with the water! Bring the water!
It's no use! This little water's barely enough!
Th—The fire's spreading too fast!
Dammit... What are we waiting for, then?! Run!
N—No... This is our last reserve of food...!
Forget her! Let's run!
Daniil left us a letter. He said you might need the USSG's help, Sonya.
After reading it, we went looking for Nearl. She told us the location of this village.
That dumbass, Daniil...
Belay it, Sonya. No more hesitance.
The five of us should be plenty! What about those two, though?
Er...
We'll go save the medical supplies!
Everyone, let's do this! After we're done, I'll make super-tasty grenki for all of us!
Sonya. Let's go together.
Anna, you absolutely didn't need to come.
The USSG's already disbanded.
Yes, by your personal statement. Being the initial proponent of the Group's establishment, shouldn't you solicit my view?
Not to mention those of Lada, Rosalind, and Natalya.
Okay, so what are your views?
We all object.
I can more or less guess what your thinking ultimately was.
To be honest, I've been deliberating over the USSG's continuation myself...
If we never encountered Rhodes Island, our lives might now be much the same as Daniil's.
But you see, Sonya... even for all Rhodes Island gives us, it doesn't mean we must lose anything.
We're not even in the same squad anymore.
Come, help me out.
This bundle's quite the heavy load.
I'll carry this side. We need to hurry up.
Sonya.
What is it?
We may not be in the same squad anymore, true, and I estimate we'll only be further split up in future, but...
At the very least, when you think to bear something alone, we'll come to your side like we are now...
Because we are eternal comrades.
Weird...
I can't believe the five of us are still together.
And we're facing a fire, just like we did back then...
If not for this fire...
No, there is no if.

lines.st: Even if this fire is already lit...
Still we will link our hands, sing and skip.
Still we will lift the same food one and all.
The frozen earth will thaw to loose soil.
No longer will the seed cling to the seed's false name.
Once the winter night is through, she will spark tender, small blossoms.
